question: What does it mean that Opus 4.7 is "dominated" on the cost-performance chart?
options: Opus has the lowest score of all five models
Another model, GPT-5.5, scores at least as well at a much lower cost
Opus was excluded from the evaluation because of its cost

private.explanation: A dominated point has some other point that is no worse on score and cheaper. GPT-5.5 scores 49.6 versus Opus 49.2 at $8.85 versus $49.21 per task. Opus is not the lowest scorer; Grok is.
